notes.text: Second trigger for the same deadlock, found in the review of PR #186 (#182): `hook pretool` goes through `boardCtx` → `loadBoard`, which now exits 2 on an invalid `effort` value — so a worker whose card edits `effort` in its worktree's board.json and typos it is locked out of every tool call, exactly as with conflict markers. The fix here (never let the hook fail on its own config; apply the policy from KB_ROOT's board) covers both.

Two more items for this card, from the review of PR #196 (#187, merged), since both live in the hook code this card rewrites:
- `test/hook.test.js` ~150 `leakHarness` scrubs `KB_*` but not `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`: with an ambient CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR naming any kb-<n>-<k> checkout, two tests fail and write `.kanban/sessions/187-1.subagents` into that real checkout. One line: `delete process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` in the harness.
- When the cwd has no board.json, `ctx.cfg.profiles` is undefined and `attemptIdentity` trusts the env, so `subagentStopHook` records `E` under whatever CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR names (a non-kb repo got a `.kanban/sessions/9-1.subagents` in the probe). Reading the policy/profiles from KB_ROOT's board — this card's item 2 — closes it; add the probe as a test.
- Wording: `src/hook.js` ~416 comment attributes the old leak line to a `claude -p` child whose cwd is the root; measured, it came from the child worktree cwd with inherited env and a tracked board.json. "both hooks" still at `src/init.js` ~243/~662, `src/model.js` ~772, `docs/harnesses.md` ~436; init.js ~243 is also stale since #125.

residual_risk: Did not touch skills/kanban/SKILL.md's merge-step steering (item 5 in the card's 'What' section) — that file is outside this card's declared scope (src/hook.js, src/board.js, src/model.js, test/hook.test.js, docs/harnesses.md)

Did not update docs/wiki/concepts/worker-identity.md even though wiki-check flagged it stale (src/hook.js and src/model.js changed) — the identity algorithm (attemptIdentity/whichAttempt) itself is unchanged; only where the policy board.json is loaded from changed, which that page doesn't describe in detail

subagentStopHook was left without its own early cfgError stand-aside check (unlike preToolHook/stopHook) since it never calls ctx.requireBoard()/getTask() and its only cfg use (worksInWorktree via ctx.cfg?.profiles) is already null-safe — but this is worth a second look if subagentStopHook grows more cfg-dependent logic later

results.summary: Fixed the PreToolUse/Stop hook deadlock: hkb hook now builds its context via a new makeHookContext (src/board.js) that never throws on an unreadable/invalid .kanban/board.json — it catches the failure and preToolHook/stopHook print one stderr line ('hkb hook: cannot read .kanban/board.json (<why>); standing aside') and exit 0 with no stdout, instead of the old makeContext->loadBoard throw that blocked every tool call under matcher "*". Also implemented the 'better' fix from the task: the policy hkb applies now comes from KB_ROOT's board.json when KB_ROOT is set (the dispatcher's own checkout, never mid-merge), falling back to the worktree's own file only when KB_ROOT is unset — so a worker can no longer loosen its own allowlist by editing board.json in its worktree, and this incidentally closes a second leak where a checkout with no board.json of its own made worksInWorktree default to false and trust a leaked KB_TASK outright. Opened PR #201 (draft): https://github.com/emyann/harness-kanban-board/pull/201
